answer: Proposed: each tide atlas bid needs a live gauge at an assigned site throughout a shared 10-minute window around a satellite nadir pass. Sites must be 1 km apart. Field auditors verify continuous placement and bind readings to key, site and window; validators cancel bids with missing, invalid or reused attestations. n keys require n simultaneous gauges and 10n gauge-minutes; one gauge cannot cover two sites. Gauges are reusable capital; deployment capacity is occupied each round. Honest field audits are essential: spoofing or collusion defeats the bound, and wealth buys capacity.
